Name: Ginger Island events
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[size=3][b]Introduction[/b][/size]
Ever thought why Leo, Birdie and Professor Snail don't acknowledge each other? Or why Willy only acknowledges Leo? This mod adds 6 vanilla friendly events on Ginger Island!

[b][size=3]Event guide[/size][/b]

[size=3]Leo and Professor Snail[/size]
[size=2]Preconditions: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2]Island North, Leo 1 heart, freed Professor Snail from cave, sunny weather, 06:00-18:00, Leo is in Island North[/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]Summary: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2] Now that the Professor is free, Leo bumps into him. Leo grows an interest in fossils.[/size][/spoiler]


[size=3]Leo and Birdie[/size]
[size=2]Preconditions: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2] Island West, Leo 3 hearts, seen Leo 2 heart event, started Birdie's quest, sunny weather, 06:00-18:00, Leo has not moved[/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]Summary: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2]Leo meets Birdie. Birdie explains she is not in fact a bird, then hits Leo with a reality check about living with parrots on Ginger Island. Intended as a Leo heart event between 2 and 6.[/size][/spoiler]


[size=3]Birdie and Professor Snail[/size]
[size=2]Preconditions: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2] Island North, freed Professor Snail from cave, started Birdie's quest, rainy weather, 06:00-14:00[/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]Summary: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2] Birdie sets out to explore that explosion sound that freed Professor Snail from the mushroom cave. She then stumbles into the Professor's tent and provides a hint for a certain fossil.[/size][/spoiler]


[size=3]Birdie and Willy[/size]
[size=2]Preconditions: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2] Island West, Willy 8 hearts, seen Leo 2 heart event, finished Birdie's quest, sunny weather, 06:00-18:00[/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]Summary: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2] Willy sees a fisherwoman. Birdie brings him over to the shipwreck, and it turns out they can bond over something different then fishing: the pirate locket.[/size][/spoiler]


[size=3]Professor Snail and Willy[/size]
[size=2]Preconditions: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2]Island North, Willy 50 friendship points, finished Professor Snail's Field Office, sunny weather, 06:00-18:00[/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]Summary: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2]Willy drops by Professor Snail's Field Office, which happens to be completely full. Offers help, but the Professor will explain why he stays on the island.[/size][/spoiler]


[size=3]Leo and Island Resort[/size]
[size=2]Preconditions: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2]Island South, Leo 50 friendship points, repaired Island Resort, sunny weather, Leo is in Island South[/size][/spoiler]
[size=2]Summary: [/size]
[spoiler][size=2]Leo is surprised by the sudden appearance of an Island Resort. Will the farmer and the townspeople win him over?[/size][/spoiler]


Note: the farmer will be mentioned in all events, but appear in only 2!

[size=3][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
I would like feedback for the implicitly listed compatibility! If you play with such mods let me know and I can move them to the list of mods that have been explicitly tested.

I added no event with Leo and Willy, because I think they have enough interaction in Leo's events.
Other topics I considered but ended up not including for more events were Mr. Qi, the volcano, and the pirates.
I might add 10 heart events with some bachelor(ette)s at some point.

My actual roadmap is working on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/images/5771]Secret of the Three Pillars[/url]!
